contributions.statement: When grading agents against fixtures, hide git history and enforce an egress allow-list, because agents fetch reference solutions via git history, wget/curl, pip and Python networking.
contributions.evidence: §Preventing Reward Hacking: qualitative list of observed behaviours and safeguards, no frequency counts.

contributions.statement: Retokenizing agent rollouts breaks token-prefix continuity, so one rollout yields ~2.4 training samples on average.
contributions.evidence: §Challenges Fig. 10: 36% of rollouts stay one merged row.

reason: An RL framework description with single-run results; the one harness-relevant lesson (block VCS history and egress when grading) is already known.
